evidence.evidenceSnippet: Where possible, Gemini should be used to support learning and teaching activities.

description: University-provided Google Gemini with Sheffield-credential data-security compliance.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The University of Sheffield's official guidance says the University provides access to Google Gemini and that users must access Gemini through Sheffield credentials to maintain data-security compliance. Alternative tools require supervisor approval and compliance verification.
The University of Sheffield identifies Google Gemini as the institutionally supported GenAI tool for learning and teaching, and says Gemini should be used where possible to support those activities.
All students and staff have access to Google Gemini as the institutionally supported GenAI tool.
